sources: Consular services information (combined): documents for certificates, passports, power of attorney, sending a body home and Welfare Board membership

facts.c: Milan Consulate family certificate: valid passport and copy, the nikahnama attested by the Law Ministry and MoFA in Dhaka and apostilled, and the birth registration or e-passport/MRP copy of every family member; apply in person
facts.q: issued by the Nikah Registry Office, attested by the Ministry of Law and the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Dhaka, and apostilled
facts.note: PDF printed 22 Sep 2025; linked from the Consular related information page (updated 2 Jul 2026)

facts.c: Every family member's birth registration, or e-passport/MRP copy, goes with a family certificate application
facts.q: Photocopy of the birth registration certificate (জন্মনিবন্ধন সনদ) of every family member, or photocopy of the e-passport/machine-readable passport of every family member

facts.c: Milan Consulate dependent certificate: valid passport and copy plus the family details certificate from the Pourashava or City Corporation, attested by the Law Ministry and MoFA and apostilled, or birth registrations, passports or NIDs of every family member
facts.q: The family details certificate (পারিবারিক বিবরণীর সনদপত্র) issued by the Pourashava (municipality)/City Corporation, attested by the Ministry of Law and the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and apostilled

facts.c: Milan Consulate dependent certificate for students and the no-income certificate (gratuito patrocinio, to appoint an Italian lawyer): a parent's affidavit on non-judicial stamp paper stating the family's annual income, attested by the Law Ministry and MoFA and apostilled, or family members' birth registrations, passports or NIDs
facts.q: Original and photocopy of an affidavit on non-judicial stamp paper given by the father/mother stating the family's annual income

facts.c: The Milan Consulate's no-income certificate is the certificate for appointing an Italian lawyer under gratuito patrocinio (state-funded legal aid)
facts.q: No-income Certificate/ GRATUITO PARTOCINIO CERTIFICATO

facts.c: Milan Consulate unmarried certificate: an unmarried certificate from the Deputy Commissioner of your home district, attested by the Law Ministry and MoFA in Dhaka and apostilled
facts.q: issued by the Deputy Commissioner (জেলা প্রশাসক, District Administrator) of the applicant's own district

facts.c: The unmarried certificate must be brought to the Milan Consulate within 6 months of its issue
facts.q: The application must be made at the Consulate General within 6 months of the date the certificate was issued.

facts.c: MoFA Dhaka verifies the unmarried certificate, so the papers must be handed in at the Milan Consulate 7 working days in advance
facts.q: so the applicant must submit it with all the documents above 7 working days in advance

facts.c: Milan Consulate marriage certificate: valid passport and copy, the spouse's passport or NID copy, and the nikahnama attested by the Law Ministry and MoFA and apostilled; apply in person
facts.q: Copy of the husband's/wife's passport/National ID card

facts.c: Milan Consulate telephonic marriage certificate (a marriage done by phone): passport, the spouse's passport/NID, the attested and apostilled nikahnama mentioning the phone marriage, the witnesses' passport, carta d'identita and permesso di soggiorno, and the Italian address and phone number used
facts.q: Photocopy of the passport, La Carta di Identitá and Permesso Di Soggiorno of the witnesses of both parties

facts.c: For a telephonic marriage certificate, give the Italian address where the marriage took place and the Italian phone number it was done over
facts.q: the telephone number in Italy over which the marriage was performed

facts.c: Milan Consulate divorce certificate: passport and copy, spouse's passport/NID copy, and the talaknama attested by the Law Ministry and MoFA and apostilled
facts.q: Copy (English/Bangla) of the talaknama (তালাকনামা, divorce deed) issued by the Nikah Registry Office

facts.c: Milan Consulate new birth registration for a child: the online bdris form copy, both parents' passport copies, the comune or hospital birth certificate naming the child and parents, and one colour photo; a parent must come in person
facts.q: The child's birth certificate issued by the Comune/hospital (naming the child and the father and mother) and its photocopy

facts.c: The child's father or mother must attend in person for the birth registration
facts.q: The child's father/mother must be present in person.

facts.c: Birth registration correction: fill the form at bdris.gov.bd/br/correction and attach supporting papers online, such as the hospital's atto di nascita to correct a name or age
facts.q: to correct the applicant's name/age, the L'atto di nascita certificate issued by the hospital) must be attached online

facts.c: The Milan Consulate issues a birth certificate in Italian against your passport and a copy of your birth registration or its online verification copy
facts.q: Photocopy of the original birth registration certificate/online verification copy

facts.c: Bangladeshi death registration at the Milan Consulate: fill the form online at bdris.gov.bd/dr/application and bring the death certificate from the comune or hospital
facts.q: The form must be filled in online (https://bdris.gov.bd/dr/application)

facts.c: One relative may apply for the death registration on behalf of the dead person
facts.q: One person (a relative, আত্মীয়) may apply on behalf of the deceased.

facts.c: Milan Consulate same person certificate (when an Italian document has your name or place wrong): passport and copy plus a copy of the Italian document with the error
facts.q: Photocopy of the Italian document in which the wrong name/place is given

facts.c: Milan Consulate lost passport certificate: all previous original passports and copies (photo page of an e-passport/MRP, pages 1 to 9 of a handwritten one) and the original police denuncia
facts.q: Original and photocopy of the G.D (DENUNCIA) issued by the police for the lost passport

facts.c: Milan Consulate nationality certificate: original passport and copy and one recent passport-size colour photo
facts.q: One recent colour photo (passport size)

facts.c: Milan Consulate education certificate: school, SSC, HSC or higher certificates and admit card, attested by the Ministry of Education and MoFA in Dhaka and apostilled
facts.q: School/SSC/HSC/higher education certificates and admit card, attested by the Ministry of Education and the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Dhaka, and apostilled

facts.c: Milan Consulate vaccination certificate: passport and the signed book with the dates of vaccinations given in Bangladesh
facts.q: The signed book giving the dates of the vaccinations (টিকা) given in Bangladesh, and its photocopy

facts.c: Milan Consulate income certificate: passport and the original Italian annual income document (CUD, Redditi, Unico or Telematico)
facts.q: The original Italian certificate of annual income (CUD/ Redditto/ Unico/ Telematico)

facts.c: No Visa Required seal (for a foreign passport holder of Bangladeshi origin, such as a child with an Italian passport): online visa form with photo, one photo, copies of the Bangladeshi passport, the parents' passports and the birth registration or NID; outside Milan add a courier return envelope
facts.q: For applicants outside Milan city, a return envelope from any courier service such as DHL, TNT for postal delivery

facts.c: No Visa Required seal: copies of the Bangladeshi passport, the parents' valid passports and the birth registration or NID
facts.q: Photocopy of the Bangladeshi valid passport, of the father's and mother's valid passports, and of the birth registration or NID

facts.c: To collect a passport at the Milan Consulate bring the receipt's customer copy, the enrolment slip or old passport copy, the previous original passport, and a police report if the old one was lost; parents come for minors
facts.q: For passport collection the applicant, and for minor children the father/mother, must be present in person.

facts.c: Passport collection needs the customer copy of the receipt and the previous original passport
facts.q: Customer copy of the receipt book (রশিদ বই)

facts.c: Milan Consulate urgent passport appointments: an alternative Google form gives an appointment date
facts.q: Alternative online link for urgent appointments (জরুরি এপয়েন্টমেন্ট): if information is given at

facts.c: No appointment is needed at the Milan Consulate for a newborn's first passport
facts.q: No appointment is needed for a newborn's first passport.

facts.c: Machine-readable passport (MRP) work stops completely from 31 December 2025; only e-passports are issued after that
facts.q: machine-readable passport (MRP) work will stop completely from 31 December 2025

facts.c: Only Bangladeshis living abroad can apply for an e-passport with a birth registration instead of an NID; the birth registration must be online in English; anyone whose MRP was made with an NID needs the NID
facts.q: The birth registration must be online in English. But if someone has earlier made their MRP with an NID, they will need the NID for their e-passport.

facts.c: To correct details in an adult's passport you need your NID and an undertaking (ongikarnama)
facts.q: To correct information in adults' passports an NID and an undertaking (অঙ্গীকারনামা) will be needed.

facts.c: Without an NID, age and details could be corrected by up to 8 years with a birth registration and Italian residence card, but such applications were accepted only until 30 June 2026
facts.q: Correction applications with a birth registration will be accepted until 30 June 2026.

facts.c: Without an NID, a birth registration and Italian residence card allowed correcting age and details by up to 8 years
facts.q: an application to correct age and information by up to a maximum of 8 years can be submitted with the birth registration and Italian residence card

facts.c: To correct details in a minor's (under 18) passport you need the birth registration and an undertaking
facts.q: To correct information in minors' (under 18) passports, the birth registration and an undertaking will be needed.

facts.c: Students get a passport fee discount with a student certificate from their school or university or the comune
facts.q: For the student discount, students will need a student certificate (ছাত্রত্ব সনদ) from the relevant educational institution or the Comune.

facts.c: A child's first e-passport needs the printed online form with barcode, both parents' passport copies, the Bangladeshi and Italian birth certificates, and a 4R-size photo
facts.q: a copy of the father's and mother's passports, the Bangladeshi and Italian birth certificates, and a 4R-size photo will be needed

facts.c: A child under 6 needs a clear 4R photo on a white background, face straight, both ears visible, no cap or band; a wrong photo means the application is refused; from age 6 the photo is taken at the Consulate
facts.q: If the photo is not correct, the application will not be accepted.

facts.c: From age 6, the e-passport photo is taken by camera in the Consulate's enrolment room
facts.q: Photos of everyone aged 6 and over will be taken directly with a camera in the enrolment room at the Consulate.

facts.c: Biometrics: no fingerprints or iris scan under age 6; fingerprints from 6 to 11; fingerprints and iris scan from 12
facts.q: All applicants aged 12 and over must give fingerprints and an iris scan.

facts.c: Children under 6 give no fingerprints or iris scan at e-passport enrolment
facts.q: At enrolment, children under 6 years old do not have to give fingerprints or an iris scan.

facts.c: Fill and print the e-passport form with Acrobat Reader, saved and reopened offline, so the full small barcode prints; a form with an incomplete (large) barcode cannot be enrolled
facts.q: The enrolment process cannot be started with an application form carrying an incomplete barcode (a large barcode).

facts.c: Most Milan Consulate certificates require the applicant to attend in person
facts.q: The applicant must be present in person.
